findings.problem: Opens with "Reuse the existing model-fetch plumbing" citing getOpenAiModels, but getOpenAiModels (src/api/providers/openai.ts:569) returns a de-duplicated string[] (response.data?.data?.map(m => m.id)) and hardcodes ${baseUrl}/models, so it cannot carry the enriched catalog fields (family, toolCalling, vision, reasoning-effort metadata, per-model url). The design correctly adds a dedicated omniRouteCatalog message pair, but the word "reuse" is misleading: only the message round-trip pattern and the message.values unsaved-edit convention are reused, not the fetch itself.
findings.fix: Reword to reuse the message pattern only, and add a dedicated fetch (e.g. getOmniRouteCatalog(base, apiKey) returning OmniRouteCatalogEntry[]); state explicitly that getOpenAiModels returns only string[] and cannot be reused.

findings.problem: Ungrammatical clause "filters is done server-side" momentarily reads as ambiguous about whether the client filters. Filtering is server-side (src/app/api/v1/vscode/[token]/models/route.ts:349 applies .filter(isUsableChatModel)), so intent is correct but wording is unclear.
findings.fix: Reword to "chat-model filtering happens server-side (isUsableChatModel), and the handler returns the enriched entries verbatim."
